schema.description: One measurement as the Withings API returns it, through the anam_withings importer (source withings): every field is Withings' own text, and the measure is a Withings code in type (1 is weight, 6 fat ratio, 11 pulse), so a reader needs Withings' table to read it. This is the Withings leaf of health.measurement, Withings' own payload shape named for its vendor (anam card 192). Version 1 is health.measurement v4 under its leaf's name (anam card 195), every rule unchanged; card 195's rename (renames/vendor-leaves.json in anam) carried each facet across as the next version of itself. Version 2 requires source_time (card 198), every other rule unchanged.

source_time.description: How Withings' clock was read (card 198): value is date as the withings plugin stores it, UTC (basis source). timezone, the zone the device was set to, stays where it is: it says where the reading was taken, not what date is read in.

value.description: The fact time as the source supplied it, as text and never rewritten: a date, a wall clock, an RFC 3339 string, or an epoch as its digits.

zone.description: The zone value is read in, and nothing else: an IANA name when one is known, UTC for a value that is UTC, else a fixed offset +HH:MM or -HH:MM. The gate refuses a name that is no zone.

basis.description: Who decided the zone. source: the source supplied it with the value, or the value is UTC by the source's own definition. configuration: a setting a person made for this source names it. assumption: the importer or writer chose it, with nothing behind it but its own default or the Definition's zone, and logged that it did.
